input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a risk associated with An e-commerce platform utilizes a cataloging system to organize and manage product listings, ensuring accurate categorization and visibility for various items. The system aims to provide relevant search results and recommendations to users based on their interests and preferences. It also seeks to maintain a comprehensive and accessible product catalogue, allowing users to discover new titles and authors.
